name: Medication Prescribed
sourceRefs: dgoradia/ncpdp testdata/sample-newrx.xml (SCRIPT v2017071, Body/NewRx/MedicationPrescribed). Compound drugs (CPD) and structured Sig deliberately deferred to a later phase — this covers the common single-drug, free-text-Sig case.

quantity/writtenDate/sig CORRECTED from required=true to required=false (2026-09-19) after running 33 real third-party SCRIPT fixtures (cosyte/ncpdp's own MIT-licensed test suite) through the real parse+validate pipeline: this ONE shared MedicationPrescribed group is referenced, unconditionally, by NewRx AND CancelRx/RxChangeRequest/RxRenewalRequest/RxFill alike, but a REAL cancelrx-request.xml sample confirmed a cancellation legitimately carries only DrugDescription+DrugCoded (enough to IDENTIFY the prescription being cancelled) with no Quantity/WrittenDate/Sig at all -- a new, full prescribing order isn't being created, so resending those details makes no sense. This engine has no per-transaction-reference override for a shared group's own internal required flags (the same class of gap the D.0 ResponsePricing fix already hit and resolved the same way) -- rather than build that machinery, this follows the same 'flexible, not rigid' precedent: NewRx's own real fixtures (dgoradia's sample, cosyte's own newrx-basic.xml) still populate all 3 in practice, so real NewRx messages validate cleanly regardless; only the now-correctly-permissive CancelRx/RxChangeRequest/RxRenewalRequest/RxFill case actually changes behavior.
